White Whisper Demo Is Now Available
events.summary: The distress signal has been received. The airlock is open. Your mission begins now.After months of development, we're excited to present the first playable demo of White Whisper.In the demo, you take on the role of Dr. Elara Wynn, who awakens from cryosleep to investigate a distress call from the research vessel U.S.S. events.title: White Whisper at IntoGames 2026 in Ostrava
events.summary: Hello everyone!We're excited to announce that White Whisper will be showcased at IntoGames 2026 in Ostrava.If you're attending the event, stop by our booth and try the game for yourself. You'll have the opportunity to explore the abandoned research vessel U.S.S. Sentinel, experience the atmosphere of White Whisper, and get a glimpse of what awaits in the full game.We would also love to hear your feedback and talk with you about the game's development, inspirations, and future plans.IntoGames 202
